ModMetaData.name: Age of Migrations: Late Rome
ModMetaData.author: syneezvetik
ModMetaData.description:
The armies of the late Roman Empire, around 400-450 AD, in RimWorld style.
Western Empire: - Ridge helmet and gilded officer's ridge helmet - Red tunic and red military cloak
Eastern Empire: - Spangenhelm with mail neck guard - White-and-purple tunic and purple military cloak
Shared: - Lorica hamata (mail), lorica squamata (iron and gilded scale) - Spatha, gilded spatha, hasta spear - Plumbata darts, spiculum javelin, sling and arcuballista (hand crossbow) - Oval and round shields in western and eastern colors. Shields are worn in their own slot, so they work with any weapon, and they block arrows, bullets and some melee hits from the front.
Armor and weapons are made at the smithy (needs Smithing), clothes at the tailoring bench.
Work in progress: factions and more peoples of the migration era are coming.
